question: What is the relation of all things to the Lord?
premises: All things are strung in him like gems on thread.
inference: The Lord is the sole support and inner presence of the universe.
uncertainties: Kashmirian recension wording; fused compound kept as one token.
plain_english: Nothing is higher than me; all this is strung in me like gems on a thread; though formless, I stand within all.
